Nexio packages the following components only for local, in-browser OCR:

- Tesseract.js 7.0.0 — Apache License 2.0
- tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 — Apache License 2.0
- @tesseract.js-data/por 1.0.0 — MIT License

The Apache License 2.0 text is included as LICENSE-TESSERACT-CORE.txt.
No receipt image is transmitted to these projects or to a remote OCR service.
